_about: Legacy upload-sheet specification for sum-insured subtypes. All paths relative to /home/user/udogg/wrapper/eb-backend_copy. Subtype ids from app/Helpers/constant.php:34-69 (class SuminsuredSubType). sample_type_id from database/seeds/MasterSumInsuredSubTypeSeeder.php; id->file from database/seeds/SampleUploadSeeder.php.

_importerRules.headingSlug: WithHeadingRow + WithGroupedHeadingRow; config/excel.php:60 formatter='slug' => Str::slug(header,'_') (lower-case, whitespace/hyphen->underscore, trims). So any spelling that slugs equal is accepted: 'Sum Insured','sum insured','SUM_INSURED' => sum_insured. 'Suminsured' => suminsured (different key!).
_importerRules.sheets: Only sheet index 0 is imported (sheets() returns a single instance, PolicyConfiguratorSumInsuredImport.php:59-64). SkipsEmptyRows. chunkSize 5.
_importerRules.noExplicitValidation: No WithValidation; failures surface as PHP ErrorException (undefined array key) caught by controller => {status:false,message:'Please upload proper excel file'} (PolicyConfigurationController.php:2853, 2963, 3038) or Exception => {status:false, errors:<message>}.

flagParsing.claim_rate: in ['Yes','Y','yes','y',1,'1'] => 1 else 0 (e.g. I:267-270). 'YES'/'Y ' uppercase 'YES' NOT matched
flagParsing.isOpd: is_opd_rate=1 iff raterType==RaterType::OPD (I:75-79). 'Is Opd Sum Insured' sheet column is never read.

_importerRules.ageBand: getAgeBand (I:944-975): spaces removed; '>N'->'N-120'; '<N'->'0-N'; all digits 'N'->'N-N'; otherwise verbatim (e.g. '18-25').
_importerRules.preImportDelete: Generic branch deletes prior IPD rates for the policy before import: si_file => where relation_permilly NULL, total_premium NULL, is_opd_rate=0, is_enchance_flex_rate=0, is_exceptional_rate=0 (PCC:2834); in_suminsured_file additionally cover_type NULL (PCC:2943); opd_si_file => is_opd_rate=1 (PCC:3022).

siType.3 Individual+Family: two slots: si_file => cover_type=2 (FAMILY) (PCC:2832-2843); in_suminsured_file => cover_type=1 (INDIVIDUAL) (PCC:2941-2953) uploadType 19 (PCC:2948); create endpoint: suminsured_file => FAMILY (PCC:5170-5176), in_suminsured_file (PCC:5272-5332). Same sheet layout for both slots.

_variants.ipdVsOpd: OPD sheet uploaded via opd_si_file with opd_suminsured_type/sub_type (PCC:2970-3040, 5385-5475); importer gets raterType=OPD => is_opd_rate=1. Same layout as IPD for each subtype. Samples with an 'Is Opd Sum Insured' Y/N column: ipd_opd_age_suminsured_sample_38.xlsx (Age,Sum Insured,Is Opd Sum Insured; subtype 2), ipd_opd_grade_wise_suminsured_sample_40.xlsx (Grade; subtype 3), ipd_opd_designation_wise_suminsured_sample_41.xlsx (Designation; subtype 4), ipd_opd_member_suminsured_sample_49.xlsx (relation,suminsured ; subtype 6): column ignored by importer. BUG in legacy: OPD member-wise (17) re-import at PCC:3016 uses $request->si_file instead of opd_si_file.
_variants.enhanceFlex: No sheet. Enhance/flex SI comes from form array in_sum_insured[].{value,is_enchance_flex_rate=1} => flat_suminsured rows with is_enchance_flex_rate=1 (PCC:2124, 2503-2515, 2580-2590). Validation rule PCC:2124.
_variants.topUp: topup_si_file (PCC:5343-5380): subtype 8/30 => PolicyCustomRateImport on the top-up policy; any other subtype => PolicyConfiguratorSumInsuredImport(configuredTopupPolicyId, topup_suminsured_type, topup_suminsured_sub_type). Sheet layouts identical to the base-policy ones.
_variants.exceptionalRate: exceptional_rates[i].si_file => PolicyConfiguratorSumInsuredImport with exceptionalRateId; rows get is_exceptional_rate=1, exceptional_rate_id; coverType/raterType NULL (PCC:914-925, 3366-3376).

8.name: Base Wise SI & Premium
8.notes: TOP-UP policy sheet, parsed by PolicyCustomRateImport (ToCollection, NO heading row: raw cell grid) not the heading-row importer (PCC:2764-2781, 5170-5181). No sample file exists in public/SampleFormat (seeder sample_type_id=NULL, MasterSumInsuredSubTypeSeeder.php id=8); the closest shipped sample is the subtype-30 workbook. Sheet semantics are decided by the BASE policy's suminsured_subtype_type_id (C:46) when topup subtype != 30 (C:201 else-branch). Row 0 is skipped as header (C:203-207). Rows whose column index 1 equals literal 'suminsured' are SI-header rows holding top-up SI values across columns 2.. (C:213-217); all other non-empty rows are premium rows: col0 = key (age band / grade / designation / relation name / state name; unused for FLAT), col1 = base_suminsured, col2.. = premium aligned under the SI-header row's columns (C:250-320). Rows after the LAST SI-header row are attached to it; only the last SI block collects premium rows (C:233-240) - effectively ONE SI-header block per sheet is supported. Cells equal to 'NA' or null SI are skipped (C:276). Base-subtype variants handled: FLAT(1), AGE(2), GRADE(3), DESIGNATION(4), MEMBER(6), STATE_WISE(7); others produce no rows (UNKNOWN/unsupported). For GRADE/DESIGNATION/MEMBER/STATE the label in col0 is matched against base policy's existing rates (by name) to get ids; an unmatched label silently reuses the previous iteration's id/undefined (C:322-376, no error).

matrix.siHeaderRow: row where col B == literal 'suminsured'; cols C.. = top-up SI values

30.name: Based on Base SI & Topup Premium
30.notes: TOP-UP matrix parsed by PolicyCustomRateImport (ToCollection, raw grid, no heading slug) (C:50-200); selected when topup policy subtype==30 (C:46-48). Uploaded via topup_si_file (PCC:5343-5380) or si_file/in_suminsured_file for subtype 30 (PCC:2764, 2872). Two header rows (row indices 0 and 1). Row 0: B1='Top-up Factor' (label), C1='Top-up Suminsured' (label, informational). Row 1: A2='Base SI / Deductible' (literal, C:67), B2=top-up factor name (C:61 reads $collection[1][1]), C2.. = numeric top-up SI values (is_numeric test, C:72). Data rows (index>=2): A=base SI, B=factor value, C..=premium for that (base SI, factor value, top-up SI). Zero/blank premium skipped (C:78). Factor name must equal one of 'Age','Grade','Designation','Family Construct','Family Group' (case-sensitive) else no factor column is set (C:97-186). Age value is stored VERBATIM (no getAgeBand) in master_policy_rates.age (C:97-99). Family Construct -> no_of_adult/no_of_children via getConstructCount; Family Group -> MasterFamilyGroup firstOrCreate -> family_group_id (C:110-185).
30.tax: addTax(premium, tax) = premium*(1+tax/100) (helper.php:4534); tax% = request premium_tax when premium_tax_type==1 else 0 (PCC:5346-5349). Stored in `tax` column.
